title: Molecular Design, Spectroscopic, DFT, Pharmacological, and Molecular Docking Studies of Novel Ruthenium(III)-Schiff Base Complex: An Inhibitor of Progression in HepG2 Cells.
authors: Noureldeen, Amani F H; Aziz, Safa W; Shouman, Samia A; Mohamed, Magdy M; Attia, Yasmin M; Ramadan, Ramadan M; Elhady, Mostafa M
journal: International journal of environmental research and public health
one_liner_zh: 该文研究钌(III)-席夫碱配合物的合成、表征及抗癌活性，分子对接仅涉及小分子与DNA的弱结合，非TF-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: A novel ruthenium(III)-pyrimidine Schiff base was synthesized and characterized using different analytical and spectroscopic techniques. Molecular geometries of the ligand and ruthenium complex were investigated using the DFT-B3LYP level of theory. The quantum global reactivity descriptors were also calculated. Various biological and molecular docking studies of the complex are reported to explore its potential application as a therapeutic drug. Cytotoxicity of the complex was screened against cancer colorectal (HCT116), breast (MCF-7 and T47D), and hepatocellular (HepG2) cell lines as well as a human normal cell line (HSF). The complex effectively inhibited the tested cancer cells with variable degree with higher activity towards HepG2 (IC(50) values were 29 muM for HepG2, 38.5 muM for T47D, 39.7 muM for HCT, and 46.7 muM for MCF-7 cells). The complex induced apoptosis and cell cycle arrest in the S phase of HepG2 cells. The complex significantly induced the expression of H2AX and caspase 3 and caspase 7 gene and the protein level of caspase 3, as well as inhibited VEGF-A and mTOR/AKT, SND1, and NF-kB gene expression. The molecular docking studies supported the increased total apoptosis of treated HepG2 cells due to strong interaction of the complex with DNA. Additionally, the possible binding interaction of the complex with caspase 3 could be responsible for the elevated activity of caspase 3-treated cells. The score values for the two receptors were -3.25 and -3.91 kcal/mol.
abstract_zh: 合成了一种新型钌(III)-嘧啶席夫碱，并采用不同的分析和光谱技术对其进行了表征。利用DFT-B3LYP理论水平研究了配体和钌配合物的分子几何结构，同时计算了量子全局反应性描述符。报道了该配合物的多种生物学和分子对接研究，以探索其作为治疗药物的潜在应用。针对结直肠癌（HCT116）、乳腺癌（MCF-7和T47D）和肝细胞癌（HepG2）细胞系以及人正常细胞系（HSF）筛选了该配合物的细胞毒性。该配合物有效抑制了所测试的癌细胞，抑制程度各异，对HepG2的活性最高（IC(50)值分别为HepG2 29 μM、T47D 38.5 μM、HCT 39.7 μM和MCF-7 46.7 μM）。该配合物诱导HepG2细胞凋亡，并将细胞周期阻滞在S期。该配合物显著诱导了H2AX、caspase 3和caspase 7基因以及caspase 3蛋白水平的表达，同时抑制了VEGF-A、mTOR/AKT、SND1和NF-kB基因表达。分子对接研究支持了处理后的HepG2细胞总凋亡增加，这归因于该配合物与DNA的强相互作用。此外，该配合物与caspase 3的可能结合相互作用可能是caspase 3处理细胞活性升高的原因。两个受体的评分值分别为-3.25和-3.91 kcal/mol。
